a.lede: EV battery fires are highly dangerous and difficult to extinguish, but is launching a battery pack out of the car a smart or realistic solution?
a.title: These experimental EV batteries can eject themselves during a fire

b.lede: Today's EV batteries could let you power specific appliances or your entire house. But a few factors line up to make that idea a non-starter for most folks.
b.title: Your EV's battery is big enough to run your house — here's what stops most people
